==Information==
<big>
<span lang="sr" dir="ltr">This page classifies different units to different ranks depending on how good they are in most modes. DPS is the main factor in this list, although all aspects are considered such as SPA, AoE, Range, Placement, Etc. Keep in mind that the rankings are not completely indicative of a units' power - some may be better or worse in certain maps or gamemodes.</span></big>

{{TierList/Item|Griffin (Reincarnation)
|Description="No" DPS, "No" AoE, infinite buff range. Buffs all players units by 100%, (Stacks with [[Commander]], [[Elfy (Sylph)]] and [[Wind Dragon]]) making him very useful for story, portals and raids.
}}

{{TierList/Item|Elfy (Sylph)
|Description=Low DPS, Medium SPA, Big AoE Circle and Medium Range. Leafy literally one of the best buffing support units in the game. Buffs all magic damage in range by 50% for 30 seconds, making her the best magic buff unit. She has medium range for a support. Her buff ability known as 'Verdant Enchantment' available upon placement.
* Recommended Curse: [[Image:Range icon.png|18px]] (You want a +Range +SPA Curse)
}}


{{TierList/Item|Commander
|Description=One of the best buffing support units in the game. Buffs all physical damage in range by 25% for 20 seconds, making him the best physical buff unit. Commander also IS a summoner, which means he can also deal damage too. His buff ability known as 'Dedicate your hearts!' available upon placement.
* Recommended Curse: [[Image:Range icon.png|18px]] (You want a +Range +SPA Curse)
}}

{{TierList/Item|Wind Dragon
|Description=One of the best buffing support units in the game. Buffs all magic damage in range by 30% for 20 seconds, making her the second best magic buff unit. She has decent range for a support, giving a little wiggle room for spreading units out a tad bit more than [[Sakuro]]. She is also a '''Hybrid''' unit, meaning magic hill units can be buffed as well. 6 of her can be placed allowing you to spread her out to all groups of units on the map. Her buff ability known as 'Sky Enchantment' available upon placement.
* Recommended Curse: [[Image:Range icon.png|18px]] (You want a +Range +SPA Curse)
}}

{{TierList/Item|Idol (Star)
|Description="No" DPS, "No" AoE, Infinite Range. Oshy is one of the most UNIQUE units in-game as she is the first EVER unit to be able to reduce the upgrade cost for units (20% reduction) and also buff the units (permanent + 15% damage increase), making Sakura now obsolete. Her ability is passive, meaning that it happens on it's own, it doesn't require you to click a button to activate this passive, making this unit very convenient for afk farming! This supporting ability is ver useful as it will help to cut the cost of some units who are really expensive while also buffing units! This supporting passive is not only useful in infinite, but also in progressive stages as it would help make units more affordable, especially in challenges like High Cost and Triple Cost! Oshy is currently tradeable but you can also now obtain her from banner! The only downside to this unit is that her support passive is not global, meaning that it only affects the person who placed Oshy's units, which makes her less viable in terms of leaderboard runs as everyone would waste a slot to use her, however, she is viable in every other mode in-game!
<br>
*  Recommended Traits: [[Image: Trait Golden.png|18px]]}}

==Stat Rankings==

Per-Unit (single) DPS is usually what most people in the community talk about as calculations are easier without taking into account number of placement. Please keep in mind that while certain characters' singular DPS may be higher than others, placement limits affect Total DPS significantly.

DPS accounts for the DMG (Damage) of a unit divided by its SPA (Attack Speed). The Total damage of a unit can be higher or lower as some units can only be placed 3, 4, 5, etc. amount times.
